title: Camera Settings
failed_to_load_info: Failed to load camera info: {{ err }}
settings_applied: Camera settings applied — capture restarting with new configuration.
failed_to_apply: Failed to apply camera settings: {{ err }}
no_devices_hint: No V4L2 devices found. Running in Docker? Pass
resolution_help: Detection and segmentation split each frame into overlapping tiles, so small objects keep their detail. A higher resolution sharpens the picture but needs more processing.
stereo_overlay_help: Blends the camera's left and right images into a single overlaid view for the stream and detection. When enabled, use the 3D button on the live video to adjust blend and alignment.
network_help: The device pulls the video from the Conecsa camera app running on the remote camera, over its hotspot or a direct Wi-Fi link. Enter the address, port and token the app shows.
token_replace_hint: The new token replaces the stored one when you apply.
token_first_hint: Type it as the app shows it. Hyphens and capitals are added for you; they make no difference.
hotspot_suggestion: Suggested from the Wi-Fi gateway ({{ address }}). Check that it matches the address shown in the app before applying.
address_required: Enter the remote camera's IPv4 address.
port_invalid: The port must be a number between 1 and 65535.
token_required: Enter the token shown in the app.
source_applied: Capture source applied — the camera is reconnecting.
ap_confirm_body: With no router, the device can serve the Wi-Fi network for the remote camera itself: the network is named after the device, and the remote camera joins it with the passphrase you set here. Or apply without it, when the remote camera's own hotspot is the link.
ap_started_await_address: Access point on. Join it from the remote camera: its address is suggested here as soon as it joins — then apply.
ap_station_suggestion: Suggested by the access point: the remote camera that joined got {{ address }}. Check it against the app before applying.
ap_active_no_station: No remote camera has joined yet.
status_not_applied: The selected source has not been applied yet — the status above is the current source's.
detail_unauthorized: The remote camera rejected the token
detail_rate_limited: Too many failed attempts — the remote camera is refusing connections for a moment
detail_unreachable: The remote camera cannot be reached
detail_stalled: The remote camera stopped sending video
detail_bad_stream: The remote camera sent an invalid video stream
